symptom: Self-maintenance structured QA accepted Black and isort commands over unrelated absolute directories named modman, modstore_server, and tests even when the policy supplied authoritative expected base and target refs.
root_cause: The exact-ref matcher correctly rejected unbound diff-helper evidence but then unconditionally fell back to a legacy basename-only full-scope matcher, which could not prove that the checked directories belonged to the reviewed target branch.

     ):
         return True

executable_template.applicability_check: Call the Black or isort command matcher with expected_base_ref and expected_target_ref plus a successful-looking full-scope command that points at unrelated absolute directories with the expected basenames; the vulnerable matcher returns true.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Reuse the exact-ref fail-closed policy: after the authoritative diff-helper match fails, reject the command whenever either expected ref is present, and retain the legacy full-scope fallback only for callers that provide no ref contract.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the two fail-closed returns and their focused regressions together; until a replacement worktree-identity binding exists, disable unattended merge rather than accepting basename-only full-scope evidence for a ref-bound review.
